steps.caption: Open More → Intelligence, then the Quality tab.
Totals: items to look at, open changes, recommendations and the number of checks.
Eleven checks, each with an exact count. A check that fails to run says 'Unavailable' — never zero.
Outdated information: requirements not updated for six months and old availability. Click a check to open it.
Missing information: live requirements with no area, budget or move-in date. Ask the client.
Contradictory information: two different values for the same thing, waiting for you to decide.
Stale property quotations: past their validity date — like the Skyline quote from February.
Also checked: unsupported assumptions, unverified requirements, old employment, records with no source and duplicates.
Detected changes: each with old → new value, date, source and which deals were flagged.
Correct status: if a change is wrong, open 'Correct status', choose a status and give a reason. It is kept in the history.
Acknowledge: you have seen and handled the change. Dismiss: it doesn't matter. Acknowledge the area change.
At the bottom, Recommended next actions, each with why, evidence, sources and next step.
Scan for changes re-checks your records now. It also runs by itself whenever records change.
The result says how many changes were found. Nothing here edits a record or sends anything.
